november_explicit_outcome_export.semantics: Source-reported booleans, not audit-derived failures. Current pinned evaluator computes required F2P/P2P subset of PASSED, but also emits False on missing output or exception; preserve unknown failure reason. No proof this exact evaluator revision produced the run.

swe_bench_pro.provenance_blocker: Pro V2 README identifies 642 Harbor tasks; legacy original release is 731 tasks. S3 keys/configs have no dataset commit/Harbor split attestation; count/ID overlap is insufficient for V2. Review a separate legacy population rather than relabeling.
metadata_anomalies: Sample claude-opus-4-1-paper config identifies claude-4-sonnet-20250514; sample claude-sonnet-4-paper identifies claude-opus-4-1-20250805. Do not label by prefix alone.
README paper $2 and dated no-cap summaries are not exact configs: sampled paper costs include 1/2/4 and call limits 50/100; sampled dated runs still have total_cost_limit=5000 in some configs.
One sample per run establishes that sample only; model homogeneity across every trajectory not audited.
swe_bench_pro.feasibility: November legacy export is a concrete patch + explicit outcome candidate. Other runs have test-output objects, not verified task-level resolved exports in this audit. Historical task/base/required-test provenance, population gaps, metadata anomalies and rights remain gates.

aggregate_only_frontier_claims.classification: Official leaderboard/metadata mentions; no matching patch export found in enumerated namespace.

monthly_leaderboard.classification: 117 entries (not necessarily unique models; GLM-5.1 is duplicated) with aggregated rangeStats, not per-attempt patches/outcomes. Problem catalog does not supply attempts.
monthly_leaderboard.hf_leaderboard_dataset_class: Gold task patches/bases only; README explicitly defines patch as gold. July 2026 task split moved to Harbor Hub, not a model-patch export.

qwen3_coder_training_attempts.limitations: Sparse ranged read verifies selected first-row-group columns against pinned public object; whole-object LFS checksum was not rehashed. No trajectories or target code were executed.
qwen3_coder_training_attempts.feasibility: Best SWE-rebench patch/outcome candidate: pinned column-range import and task/base join possible. Full cohort, exact historical input revision, generation config, selection and rights review still required; training collection, not the monthly leaderboard run.

content_policy.common_prompts: exactly rendered from the selected processor
content_policy.agentic_prompts: exact exposed CLI instructions and task input; unexposed built-in system prompts declared unavailable

july_2026_normalized_export.classification: Public explicit outcomes and normalized transcripts for 17 recent participants; final submitted patches deliberately omitted. Not aggregate-only, but not importable for footprint. Tool excerpts are incomplete and must not be reconstructed as final diffs.

glm51_multiharness.classification: 45 parsed rows have conversations and completed, but no model_patch or resolved field. Completed is not correctness; README GLM label does not describe all rows. Cannot import as patch/outcome cohort.

whitecircle_glm51_success_only.classification: Success-selected traces; no failed-attempt coverage and no dedicated final patch/outcome fields declared. Bodies not downloaded. Not a fair all-attempt footprint cohort.

swe_rebench.version_boundary: SWE-rebench original, monthly leaderboard, July Harbor cohort and language-agnostic SWE-rebench-V2 are separate populations. Original Qwen3 training export does not attest V2 or monthly leaderboard execution.

config_evidence.classification: 112 Python predictions, 113-task claim, 2110 harness result objects. Do not interpret generation=false placeholder results outside the submitted cohort as attempted failures.

config_evidence.prediction_labels: 113 Python rows identify Kodah (gpt-5-mini); 269 other-language model_name_or_path values are null

config_evidence.policy: 70 Feature + 312 complementary task runs, 29 infrastructure empty-patch retries; five temporal-isolation replacements and frozen-set re-evaluation described by submitter

swe_polybench_verified.classification: Strongest additional repository-patch candidate found: recent GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.8 predictions with explicit sampled pass/fail and public exact base joins. GPT-5-mini candidate also available. Java out of supported scope; predeclare Python/JS/TS populations; audit all outcome bodies and rights before import.
swe_polybench_verified.benchmark_repository_license: MIT; does not clear all task source/model-output rights

livecodebench.classification: Public generated code + explicit grading; model identity from folder rather than row config. Standalone contest-program generation, not repository repair/base patch. Needs independent benchmark/scoring definition, not a forced patch import. Inspected official data mainly 2025-era models, no verified 2026 frontier export located.

aider_polyglot.classification: 225-exercise aggregate per-model summaries/configs (including GPT-5 high); no per-task final source/diffs plus explicit attempt grading identified in inspected official tree/pages. Do not infer individual attempts from pass counts.
aider_polyglot.feasibility: Blocked until public complete final code/diff and explicit outcome export, benchmark base/population and rights are pinned.

bigcodebench.classification: Official landing page screened only; no recent per-attempt export verified here. Completion benchmark, not automatically a repair-patch import.

terminalbench.classification: Old repo redirect only; not an artifact audit of Terminal-Bench 2/4. No conclusion on availability or model coverage.

recommended_next_actions.action: Audit SWE-PolyBench Verified HMigBot Opus 4.8 and iSWE GPT-5.4 public source cohorts, every outcome body and base/provenance; predeclare language tracks. Do not publish scores before rights/selection checks.
Use pinned Qwen3-Coder SWE-rebench model_patch/resolved columns for an offline import pilot with explicit failures; audit historical task/base revisions and full training collection population.
Consider November Pro only as a distinct legacy population if authorized; keep V2 blocked and do not count Oct/Nov Gemini as independent new models on a matching sample.
Do not import July SWE-rebench frontier transcripts or GLM success-only training traces by reconstructing diffs; await actual submitted-patch export, without contacting upstream on owner behalf.

limitations: Anonymous availability is not a redistribution license.
Full S3 object inventories were enumerated, but only representative object bodies were read; per-run population and all outcome bodies are not fully validated.
Hugging Face mutable API observations discover pinned revisions; dataset-server previews are navigation only, not historical immutable evidence. Qwen verification uses pinned raw Parquet ranges.
Pinned current task matches do not establish those snapshots were used by historical runs.
No absence/missing/empty artifact is treated as an audit-inferred failed attempt. Explicit upstream placeholder or error booleans require provenance-sensitive interpretation.
